description: AGP Limited began commercial operations in 1989 as an independent pharmaceutical manufacturing company in Karachi. It manufactures, markets and sells pharmaceuticals and healthcare products in the domestic and export market, growing through licensing arrangements with international companies as well as its own brands, and describes itself as one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in Pakistan. Its product list blends its own range of branded generics with branded products it licenses from principals abroad.
